note: Rustic Alberta Parks campground next to the Oldman River, 45 km N of Crowsnest Pass on the Forestry Trunk Road (Hwy 940), then 3 km W on Oldman River Road (gravel). Sites for tents and RVs among tall spruce; a group site with a rustic shelter sits on the river bank. Bring drinking water (the hand pump is not potable) and firewood. The neighbouring areas have designated OHV trails. --Claude
summary: Alberta Parks page (Jun 5, 2026): 10 unserviced sites at C$23, season (manual) confirmed; booking reservable (derived) -> first-come only; vault toilets added; DROP CANDIDATE on the page's OHV wording; riverview -> not waterfront recommended.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (OHV): the campground page says 'The neighbouring areas offer designated OHV trails, making this the perfect place to set up base for a getaway.' The agency markets it as an OHV base next to designated OHV trails.

WATERFRONT (stored riverview, checked hard): RECOMMEND not waterfront. On imagery (Esri, ~0.49 m/px) the campground road runs along the edge of a meadow and the sites are in dense spruce between it and the Oldman River, which is ~50-60 m south of the road and pin with a continuous conifer screen; no site, clearing or gap toward the river is visible, and the page itself says the sites are 'all surrounded by towering trees'. No site numbers published. Nothing supports a view of the river from a site.
